steps.instruction:
Ingredients: 200g All-purpose Flour
150g Granulated Sugar
14g Poppy Seeds
1 1/2 tsp Baking Powder
1/2 tsp Baking Soda
1/2 tsp Salt
270g Unfed Sourdough Discard
90g Vegetable Oil
2 Large Eggs
Zest of 2 Lemons (16g)
30g Lemon Juice
1/2 tsp Lemon Extract (optional)
50g Granulated Sugar for topping
Zest of 1 Lemon (8g) for topping
Preheat the oven to 425 degrees. Prepare a muffin tin with paper liners, or grease and lightly flour the pan.
Place the topping sugar and lemon zest in a small bowl and combine.
Whisk in the lemon extract, if using.
Combine the contents of the two bowls. Stir gently until no dry streaks remain. Some lumps may be present.
Fill each muffin cup 3/4 of the way full.
Sprinkle the lemon sugar topping evenly over the batter.

Bake at 425 degrees for 5 minutes. Reduce the oven temperature to 350 degrees and continue baking until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean and the tops are lightly brown, 15–18 minutes more.
Transfer the muffins to a cooling rack. Let cool in the pan for 5 minutes, then remove the muffins from the pan and cool completely.
Store in an airtight container on the counter for up to 5 days.
